WITH base AS (
  SELECT c.Gene, c.Cancer, TRY_CAST(c."logFC" AS DOUBLE) AS lfc, TRY_CAST(c."p-value adjusted" AS DOUBLE) AS p
  FROM cancer_cptac c WHERE c.Cancer IN ('Colon AC','Lung AC','Ovary SC')
),
piv AS (
  SELECT Gene,
    MAX(CASE WHEN Cancer='Colon AC' THEN lfc END) AS lfc_colon, MAX(CASE WHEN Cancer='Lung AC' THEN lfc END) AS lfc_lung, MAX(CASE WHEN Cancer='Ovary SC' THEN lfc END) AS lfc_ovary,
    MAX(CASE WHEN Cancer='Colon AC' THEN p END) AS p_colon, MAX(CASE WHEN Cancer='Lung AC' THEN p END) AS p_lung, MAX(CASE WHEN Cancer='Ovary SC' THEN p END) AS p_ovary
  FROM base GROUP BY Gene
  HAVING MAX(CASE WHEN Cancer='Colon AC' THEN lfc END) IS NOT NULL AND MAX(CASE WHEN Cancer='Lung AC' THEN lfc END) IS NOT NULL AND MAX(CASE WHEN Cancer='Ovary SC' THEN lfc END) IS NOT NULL
     AND MAX(CASE WHEN Cancer='Colon AC' THEN p END) IS NOT NULL AND MAX(CASE WHEN Cancer='Lung AC' THEN p END) IS NOT NULL AND MAX(CASE WHEN Cancer='Ovary SC' THEN p END) IS NOT NULL
),
sig AS (
  SELECT Gene, lfc_colon, lfc_lung, lfc_ovary, p_colon, p_lung, p_ovary,
    (p_colon<0.01 AND lfc_colon>=0.5) AS up_colon, (p_colon<0.01 AND lfc_colon<=-0.5) AS dn_colon,
    (p_lung<0.01  AND lfc_lung>=0.5)  AS up_lung,  (p_lung<0.01  AND lfc_lung<=-0.5)  AS dn_lung,
    (p_ovary<0.01 AND lfc_ovary>=0.5) AS up_ovary, (p_ovary<0.01 AND lfc_ovary<=-0.5) AS dn_ovary
  FROM piv
),
scored AS (
  SELECT *, (up_colon::INT+dn_colon::INT+up_lung::INT+dn_lung::INT+up_ovary::INT+dn_ovary::INT) AS n_sig,
     (up_colon OR up_lung OR up_ovary) AS any_up, (dn_colon OR dn_lung OR dn_ovary) AS any_dn
  FROM sig
)
SELECT s.Gene, pr."Gene" AS gene_name,
  ((CASE WHEN s.up_colon THEN 'U' WHEN s.dn_colon THEN 'D' ELSE '.' END)||
   (CASE WHEN s.up_lung  THEN 'U' WHEN s.dn_lung  THEN 'D' ELSE '.' END)||
   (CASE WHEN s.up_ovary THEN 'U' WHEN s.dn_ovary THEN 'D' ELSE '.' END)) AS sign_colon_lung_ovary
FROM scored s JOIN proteinatlas pr ON pr."Ensembl"=s.Gene
WHERE s.n_sig>=2 AND s.any_up AND s.any_dn
ORDER BY s.Gene;
